rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Discord MCP server that provides AI assistants with comprehensive Discord bot capabilities through a route-generated tool system and real-time Gateway events. The implementation features a catalog-driven approach where Discord API endpoints are automatically converted into MCP tools, organized into modular packs (CORE, ADMIN, MEDIA, COMMUNITY, DEVTOOLS) that can be selectively enabled, with built-in security through allow-lists for guilds/channels, human-in-the-loop confirmations for destructive operations, and sanitized mention handling. It supports both REST API operations for standard Discord actions like messaging, role management, and channel administration, plus Gateway integration for real-time event streaming with configurable filters, making it valuable for building Discord moderation bots, community management tools, and AI assistants that need to interact with Discord servers while maintaining security boundaries.
